documentation.rationale: The identity half is strong: VIN, a clean CARFAX, two owners with a clear chain, and no open recalls. The maintenance half is weak: a 7-year, roughly 29,500-mile stretch with no reported service, and no brake fluid, transmission, differential or coolant records. Fee terms are partly vague (possible $399 add-ons).

condition.rationale: Photos show clean paint, no visible damage and a tidy interior, with modest wear on the steering-wheel rim. CARFAX reports no damage and two oil changes in the last 15 months. The underside, engine bay, roof function, tire dates and cabin water evidence were not examined.

price_value.rationale: The $22,601 asking price is about $750 above the top of the $20,232-21,846 fair-value band and about $1,600 above its midpoint, before possible add-ons. Expect a time-based fluid catch-up because no records cover it.

mission_fit.rationale: It meets the mission's manual requirement, the reliable ND platform is easy to resell, and it is available now. The price sits above the ideal $10-19k band but under the $27k ceiling. It is ND1 rather than the preferred ND2.

logistics.rationale: Pasco, WA is a fly-and-drive trip from Carmel. A franchise dealer should allow a third-party PPI. CA registration of a 2018 gasoline car needs smog and VIN verification, which should be routine.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Club manual RF in Machine Gray, a premium colour. The car appears to carry the Brembo/BBS package, inferred from the photos, but that is not confirmed in the text.

ppi_focus: Gearbox: shift quality in 2nd and 3rd when cold and when fully warm, any grinding or popping out of gear, fluid condition.
Clutch engagement point and any slip in 4th-6th under load.
Cycle the RF roof several times. Check for rattles, slow or interrupted operation, targa seal water tracks and drain function.
Lift the footwell carpets and check seat-rail bolts for water ingress or corrosion.
Underside corrosion check, as this car has spent its life in Idaho and Washington.
Water pump weep hole, valve cover, front crank seal, and differential pinion and output seals for seepage.
Brake fluid moisture test, plus pad and rotor measurement, including the Brembo hardware if fitted.
Tire DOT dates, battery load test, and alignment readings.
Scan all modules for stored codes, and check Mazda Connect for ghost touches or freezes.
Paint meter on the aluminum hood, fenders and trunk, and check for repaint under the dealer vinyl.

Up: an out-the-door price negotiated into the fair-value band, with no add-ons.

Down: tire dates from 2018, gearbox grinding when warm, roof faults or water ingress found at inspection.
Down: the dealer refuses a third-party PPI or will not itemise its fees.
evidence.mission_note: A manual, low-risk ND RF that resells easily fits the enthusiast-bridge brief, though it is the ND1 engine and priced above the ideal band. The open question is the undocumented time-based maintenance, not the platform.
evidence.rationale: The CARFAX establishes identity and title well. It shows a clean title, no reported accidents, a 03/2018 build after the problem gearbox period, two owners, personal use and no open recalls. Maintenance evidence is thin: after the 2018 PDI there is no reported service for about 7 years and 29,500 miles, until an oil change in 07/2025 and another on 09/14/2026. Nothing shows a brake-fluid, transmission, differential or coolant service. That no-entry gap is not proof of neglect, but it means the time-based fluid catch-up should be assumed. The photos show a clean, apparently stock Machine Gray Club, likely with the Brembo/BBS package, and only modest steering-wheel wear. The underside, roof operation, cabin dryness and tire dates were not examined here. The $22,601 asking price sits above the $20,232-21,846 fair-value band, and the listing mentions possible add-on fees. The second owner's 11-month tenure and the duplicate title are worth a question but are not documented problems.
evidence.next_action: Email Corwin Ford asking for an itemised out-the-door quote, tire DOT and battery date photos, any owner-1 service records, and written agreement to a third-party PPI in the Tri-Cities before any deposit.
